svg.title: Proposed RNA recognition and reporter generation in six steps
svg.desc: Step one probe design. Step two shows exact antiparallel pairing of DNA recognition sequence AGTCAACATCAGTCTGATAAGCTA from 5 prime to 3 prime with the supplied miR-21-5p RNA from 3 prime to 5 prime. Step three duplex DNA cleavage, with no exact cut sites. Step four a proposed barcode reporter with unknown terminal integrity. Step five potential unverified RNA recycling. Step six reaction stopping, product verification, compatible library preparation, nanopore sequencing and barcode identification.

g.text: Separate sequence encoding from target recognition.
Complementary DNA and RNA form an antiparallel hybrid.
Duplex DNase cleaves DNA within the hybrid substrate.
A barcode-containing fragment is proposed; endpoints are unknown.
Released RNA may bind a fresh probe. Turnover remains unverified.
Verify products and prepare a compatible library before sequencing.
DNA · RNA base pairs, with opposite strand directions
PROPOSED MECHANISM / No exact cleavage sites or validated reporter ends are assigned.
